data.gender_notes: Nafisaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nafisaah is an Arabic name derived from the word Nafas, meaning breath or wind. It is a beautiful and spiritual name for a girl in Islamic culture. In the Quran, Allah (swt) mentions 'And indeed, it is in the remembrance of Allah that hearts find satisfaction.' (13:28). This name embodies the purity and cleanliness of the heart that finds satisfaction in the remembrance of Allah. It is a name that signifies sacredness and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pure and clean heart that seeks closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Nafisaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean, Sacred.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafisaah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نفيسة
in_arabic.meaning: نفيسة تعني الفتاة الجميلة ذات القيمة العالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: نفيسة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'نفيس' التي تعني الشيء القيّم والثمين. وردت كلمة 'نفيس' في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَالذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَالَّذِي أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ'، وقد وردت أيضاً في سورة التوبة الآية 8، وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، يطلق اسم نفيسة على الفتاة الجميلة ذات القيمة العالية، كما يوحي بالشخصية القيّمة والمحبوبة

in_english.name: Nafisaah
in_english.long_meaning: Nafisaah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'nafis,' which means precious, valuable, or beautiful. The term 'nafis' appears in the Quran, Surah Al-Furqan, verse 2, and Surah At-Tawbah, verse 8. In Islamic tradition, Nafisaah symbolizes a person of high value, beauty, and nobility. The name is popular across various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Pashto, and Turkish communities, reflecting its significance and appeal
